Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [page/15/Text/7] Whereas there were no expectancy effects on mood, there was a significant effect of German teachers' judgments on life satisfaction. Higher (lower) expectations uniquely predicted a more (less) favorable development of life satisfaction.

sample_type.evidence_source: [page/15/Text/7] Teachers, as central socializing persons in adolescents' lives, might influence their students' subjective well-being through their expectations.
